podcast.title: MBE Awarded (2020)
podcast.body: Mike Pender was awarded an MBE in 2020 for his services to the music industry. "Mike Pender was made an MBE in 2020, as a reward for his services to the music industry."

podcast.title: Continued Touring
podcast.body: Mike Pender continued to tour, or at least had tour dates booked, for decades after the split, with his show noted for sticking closer to a "straight guitar-based drum sound." "Pender still tours, or at least has tour dates booked over the course of the next year."

podcast.title: Formation from Original Searchers Split
podcast.body: Mike Pender formed his own touring band, "Mike Pender's Searchers," after disputes over money and his desire to be recognized as the group's star, leading to his departure from the original Searchers lineup in 1985. "Pender decided that he could make more money by touring at his own, but still doing essentially the same show, with hired backing musicians."

podcast.title: Legal Battle over Naming Rights
podcast.body: There were extensive legal battles between Mike Pender and the remaining members of The Searchers (McNally and Allen) over billing and the use of the band name, which nearly led to Pender's imprisonment. "There was a serious danger of Pender going to prison over their contractual disputes."
